transfers_requested.value:
("transfers"."status" <> 'REQUESTED' OR "transfers"."requested_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("transfers"."origin" = 'REQUEST' OR "transfers"."requested_at" IS NULL)

transfers_shipped.name: transfers_shipped
transfers_shipped.value:
("transfers"."status" IN ('SHIPPED', 'RECEIVED'))
        = ("transfers"."shipped_at" IS NOT NULL AND "transfers"."ship_date" IS NOT NULL)

transfers_received.name: transfers_received
transfers_received.value: ("transfers"."status" = 'RECEIVED') = ("transfers"."received_at" IS NOT NULL AND "transfers"."receive_date" IS NOT NULL)

transfers_note.name: transfers_note
transfers_note.value: "transfers"."note" IS NULL OR length("transfers"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

transfers_cancel_reason.name: transfers_cancel_reason
transfers_cancel_reason.value: "transfers"."cancel_reason" IS NULL OR length("transfers"."cancel_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 300

uoms_measure_unit.name: uoms_measure_unit
uoms_measure_unit.value: "uoms"."measure_unit" IS NULL OR length("uoms"."measure_unit") BETWEEN 1 AND 50
